title: Father, Father, You are by
lyrics_original: Father, Father, You are by my side
I'm not alone you are by me side
Father, Father you are by my side

bible_verses.english: Be strong and courageous, don’t be afraid, nor be scared of them; for Yahweh your God is he who goes with you. He will not fail you nor forsake you.”
teaching them to observe all things that I commanded you. Behold, I am with you always, even to the end of the age.” Amen.
I will pray to the Father, and he will give you another Counselor, that he may be with you forever,

devotional.prayer_english: Heavenly Father, thank You for the deep comfort of knowing You are always by my side. Lord Jesus, when I feel lonely or afraid, remind me of Your faithful promise to never leave me. Holy Spirit, tune my heart to Your gentle presence today. Help me walk in the peace and confidence that comes from resting in You. Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: In life's quiet valleys or bustling days, it is easy to feel isolated and overwhelmed. Yet this simple song gently anchors our hearts in the faithful presence of the Triune God. The Father watches over us, Jesus walks beside us, and the Holy Spirit lives within us. As you worship, rest in the unchanging truth that you are never alone, and let His comforting love wash over your soul.
